primary_causes.Hysteresis_Decay_Tail: 58% — Legitimate transactions occurring on the same account shortly after an elevated-risk period before P_t decays below threshold.
primary_causes.High_Volume_Entity_Jitter: 29% — Large aggregator keys experiencing intermittent moderate A_t fluctuations causing repeated step-up without sufficient inter-transaction decay time.
primary_causes.Sub_Threshold_Bursts: 13% — Clustered benign transactions with slightly elevated point-wise risk (0.35 - 0.50) causing false accumulation.
